_comment: Optional: with one env that has everything, nothing needs setting. Copy to local_settings.json (same folder) to override a default (see site_config.py). Keys under machines.<COMPUTERNAME> apply on that computer only; top-level keys apply everywhere. PYTHON empty = run_frontend.bat picks the most capable Python it finds. GEOMETRY_ENV empty = gdspy is in the same env as qiskit-metal + pyEPR. MICROWAVE_DESIGN is only needed when this folder is not inside the MicrowaveDesign repo.
